name: Mark Tedford
summary:
Mark Andrew Tedford (born June 26, 1969) is an American politician and insurance agent who is the Oklahoma House of Representatives member from the 69th district. He represents Jenks and South Tulsa.
Tedford was born in Lafayette, Louisiana, and raised in Jenks, Oklahoma, before graduating from Missouri Southern State University which he attended on a football scholarship.
